plan.name: Collect configured acceptance evidence
plan.summary: Add a shared lower-level lifecycle for configured acceptance, with trusted host-selected adapters and a separate environment evidence channel bound to fresh invocations, full test identities, package attribution, pinned source bytes and captured configuration. Validate authority, ownership, invocation support and adapter availability before preparation; safely stage the ratified sources, reject ambiguous, incomplete, stale or mismatched evidence, and retain completed and unfinished identities and reasons independently of diagnostic output. Give base checks an independent selector loop that requires an attributable completed test or compiler failure for every selector, while candidate checks require all applicable commands and selectors to pass; setup errors, cancellation, exhausted allowances and failed cleanup veto qualification without erasing earlier results. Reuse verified dependency environments and existing container isolation, keep one active candidate environment per check with disposable build outputs, share the original twelve-minute whole-run and ten-minute test-phase limits with shorter caller or preparer allowances, and retain bounded uncanceled cleanup and queue ownership through cleanup. Update SPEC.md, docs/factory.md and the README to describe this tested foundation and its limits with the existing decision citations; default native adapters, configured planning admission and external intake remain disabled, legacy Go hashes and execution stay compatible, and the merger must record the new execution-foundation decision before the next issue and perform unavailable Docker/network checks while affected real Python and TLAPS suites remain required in CI.

tests.name: TestConfiguredAcceptanceBaseCollectsIndependentFailures
tests.says: The base lifecycle attempts independent selectors after ordinary suite and compiler failures, qualifies only all-failing completed evidence, and preserves every full identity.

tests.name: TestConfiguredAcceptanceCandidateNeedsCommandsAndSelectors
tests.says: A candidate passes only when every applicable captured command and every individual selector passes; skipped phases keep their reasons and suite diagnostics never supply evidence.

tests.name: TestConfiguredAcceptanceLifecycleIsFrameworkIndependent
tests.says: Trusted fake pytest, Vitest and Jest adapters use the same lifecycle without language runtimes or invented Go package attribution; no production adapter is enabled.

tests.name: TestConfiguredAcceptanceValidatesBeforePreparation
tests.says: Invalid snapshots, execution bindings, ownership, plans, invocation forms and missing adapters are refused before preparation; environments without evidence capability cannot accept tests, and configured planning remains disabled.

tests.name: TestConfiguredAcceptanceStagesPinnedSources
tests.says: The lifecycle stages exact ratified bytes in a private copy, accepts only existing line-ending normalization, refuses unsafe or changed files, and binds fresh invocations to source, configuration and package.

tests.name: TestConfiguredAcceptanceRejectsInvalidEvidence
tests.says: Missing, duplicate, contradictory, truncated, stale and mismatched records, unattributed nonzero exits and forged diagnostics cannot become completed acceptance passes or failures.

tests.name: TestConfiguredAcceptanceRetainsStructuredReasons
tests.says: Test and compiler failures, setup failures, skipped, refused, running and unstarted work keep distinct results, full identities and reasons after diagnostic clipping and JSON transport.

tests.name: TestConfiguredAcceptanceSharesWholeRunAndPhaseDeadlines
tests.says: Selection, preparation, startup, suites and acceptance share the original shortened whole-run deadline and one test allowance across parts; later timeouts preserve earlier evidence and veto qualification.

tests.name: TestConfiguredAcceptanceInfrastructureVetoesBaseQualification
tests.says: Preparation, partial startup, launch, setup, cleanup and cancellation failures cannot qualify a base plan, even after completed failure evidence; all opened environments receive bounded uncanceled cleanup.

tests.name: TestConfiguredAcceptanceQueueRetainsAuthorityAndCleanupOwnership
tests.says: Queued acceptance uses the host's captured adapters, plan and policy, keeps its slot until cleanup ends, and serializes candidate environments across parts and admitted checks.

usage.summary: Wrote `plan.json` and ten acceptance tests covering the shared lifecycle, evidence validation, deadlines, and cleanup. The first check passed: every acceptance test fails on the base, and `repo/` remains unchanged.
